notes:
FIXED
- File watcher now uses polling — no more missed changes on macOS
- Notes no longer jump back to old folder after rename or move
- Index.md now appears in the left menu
- Editor no longer loses content or desyncs from the title
- Folder rename on disk no longer orphans subfolders
- Pinned items stay in the tree menu (pinned section is a shortcut only)
- Rename inputs now appear for notes inside pinned folders
- Auto-increment note/folder names when creating duplicates ('Untitled (2)')
- Name collision errors shown when manually renaming to an existing name
- Help vault restructured into version folder (0.1.32)

IMPROVED
- Rust Backend Engine — consolidated file I/O and DB sync (Spec 48)
- Simplified frontend file event handler — reconcileVaultFromDisk replaces 7-branch handler
- Bidirectional rename buffer handles both macOS FSEvents and PollWatcher
- Folder rename detection improved with fresh DB folder list

NEW
- Polling watcher replaces macOS FSEvents for reliable cross-platform file sync
- Consolidated DbState replaces VaultDbState for all database operations
